explication: AFT automates AWS Control Tower account provisioning and updates from Terraform account requests, then applies account-level provisioning and customization workflows. The graph preserves the request, provisioning, customization, and feature-option branches documented or represented in the source tree, plus shared AWS integration layers. Some event wiring and unsampled capabilities are documented only at a high level; their implementation-level connections are therefore omitted rather than inferred.
